description:
* Extended Three-Bedroom Mid-Terrace Home 
* No Onward Chain

An excellent opportunity to purchase this extended three-bedroom mid-terrace home, ideally suited to first-time buyers, young families or investors looking for a well-positioned property. Offered for sale with no onward chain, the property provides generous and versatile accommodation together with a convenient location close to local amenities, schools, green spaces and transport connections.

To the front, there is on-street parking and access into the property through a useful entrance vestibule.

The living room is positioned at the front of the home, providing a comfortable reception space for relaxing and entertaining.

Moving through to the dining room, there is useful under-stairs storage, with stairs leading to the first floor. An open archway leads through into the fitted kitchen, creating a good flow between the two spaces.

The kitchen is fitted with a range of wall and base cabinets complemented by work surfaces. There is space for a freestanding fridge and freezer, along with space and plumbing for a washing machine. Integrated appliances include an electric oven and gas hob.

To the first floor are three generous bedrooms, offering plenty of flexibility for a growing family, guests, home working or hobbies. The accommodation is completed by a three-piece family bathroom.

To the rear is an enclosed yard, providing a low-maintenance outdoor space which could be used for seating, entertaining or simply enjoying some fresh air.

The property is conveniently positioned close to Eldon Primary School and the popular Moor Park, while excellent transport connections provide easy access to Preston City Centre and surrounding areas.

With its extended layout, three good-sized bedrooms, no onward chain and convenient location, this property represents an excellent opportunity for a first-time buyer or investor looking for a home with plenty of potential. 

VESTIBULE   

LIVING ROOM 12' 9" x 13' 3" (3.89m x 4.04m)  

DINING ROOM 11' 4" x 11' 2" (3.45m x 3.4m)  

KITCHEN 10' x 9' (3.05m x 2.74m)  

FIRST FLOOR   

BEDROOM ONE 9' 10" x 13' 2" (3m x 4.01m)  

BEDROOM TWO 6' 7" x 13' 1" (2.01m x 3.99m)  

BEDROOM THREE 6' 6" x 11' 2" (1.98m x 3.4m)  

BATHROOM 4' 5" x 8' 3" (1.35m x 2.51m)  

  Preston city centre is a vibrant city on the north bank of the River Ribble in Lancashire, offering an excellent choice of shops, cafés, restaurants, bars and leisure facilities. Fishergate and Friargate form the main shopping streets, with further independent businesses and eateries found throughout the surrounding streets.

The city is ideally located for commuters, with Preston Railway Station providing direct rail links via the West Coast Main Line, alongside easy access to the M6, M61, M65 and M55 motorways and several international airports.

For outdoor enthusiasts, The Guild Wheel offers fantastic walking and cycling routes, including paths through Avenham and Miller Parks and alongside the River Ribble. Local education includes the University of Lancashire, St Stephen's C of E Primary School and Christ the King Catholic High School.
